verdict.rationale: LegalZoom is a SaaS that stores customer business documents in the cloud, so data-residency choice is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack never mentions letting users choose a storage region or residency. The 'unlimited cloud storage' claim is adjacent and says nothing about where data is stored or whether the user can choose.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
